in_marathi.name: Pushpender
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the soul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pushpender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pushpender is derived from two Sanskrit words: Pushp (flower) and Hander (Lord). The name signifies the one who is the Lord of the soul, the one who is the giver of strength and the one who is the embodiment of courage.
